verdict.rationale: PlayCanvas scripts and physics components support event-driven behavior (e.g., collision triggers) and the Editor module API explicitly enables automating scene manipulation and asset management tasks, which could be used to define event→action rules, but there is no dedicated rules/automation engine or AI-native trigger-action framework described. Missing for 10: an explicit rule-definition system (if-event-then-action), AI-native automation examples, and independent confirmation that such rules can be authored purely by an AI agent rather than manual scripting.
